title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1979-11-06
source: Soundboard; Sony L-750ESX-HFB Dynamicron EXCELLENT SUPER HIFI VIDEO CASSETTE-> Sony SLO-1800 STEREO VIDEOCASSETTE RECORDER-> Sony PCM-601ESD DIGITAL AUDIO PROCESSOR-> SP/DIF-> Mytek Stereo 192 Sample Rate Converter-> Upsampled to 44.1kHz/24bit->SP/DIF-> RME FIREFACE 800-> FireWire 400-> Lenovo K450e Desktop PC-> WaveLab 6.11; Mastering & Editing by Jason Chastain in Audition CC 2015; Final Mastering by Jamie Waddell in Wavelab 7.1; Track, FLAC and Pack by Norm

ai_review.summary: Fair soundboard recording of an uneven show – highlights include a lengthy Jack‑a‑Roe, dynamic Jack Straw and a strong Terrapin Station amid some pitch and mastering issues.
ai_review.review: The patched SBD source is the only fully corrected version, but it still suffers from mastering errors, pitch problems and balance quirks that keep the technical quality at a fair level. Musically the concert is mixed: the first set wanders with off‑key moments, while the second set delivers long jams and standout performances of Jack‑a‑Roe, Jack Straw, Deal and Terrapin Station. Overall the show earns a middling three‑star rating from reviewers.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed review gives a balanced 3‑star overall score; the performance has several high points but is offset by uneven playing and notable recording flaws, leading to a modest rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Patched SBD is correctly pitched, yet all official releases suffer from mastering errors: slow playback, pitch offsets (+2‑3%), uneven balance and missing portions of Space. Overall clarity is acceptable but not pristine.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is uneven with timing slips and a few average renditions, while the truncated second set compensates with extended jams (21‑min "Playing") and stronger moments, especially in the middle.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is highlighted for taking the lead on Jack-a-Roe, delivering a dynamic Jack Straw for Clive, and being 'struck by a mood' during Deal.
